title: No Music Discs from Creepers
description: Removes music discs from creeper's loot table when killed by a skeleton. You can find all C418s music discs in dungeons now.
body:
It has always bothered me how easy it is to get music discs in Minecraft and how the only music discs you can find in dungeons are 13 and Cat (and Otherside). I'm a big fan of mining, so why not give myself another reason to explore the caves?

Removes music discs from creeper's loot table when killed by a skeleton. You can find all C418s music discs in dungeons now.

Info:
- The chance of finding any music disc in a dungeon chest remains the same (total weight 32).
- Otherside is remained unchanged.
- 13 is 1.5x rarer.
- Cat is 1.5x rarer (They both are rarer because I wanted to ensure that the total weight is 32)
- All C418s music discs (other than Cat and 13) combined have the same chance of being found as Cat or 13. It means that for example Ward itself is 10x rarer than Cat.
